capabilities.punctuationCompressionLimit: Native editing trim depends on browser support. Read-only full-width marks use bounded, measured glyph geometry; Latin punctuation, code and URL/path text are excluded.
capabilities.roleFontLimit: Named local fonts with unicode ranges, followed by the existing document font; unavailable fonts fall back. Generic families do not create a local font face.
capabilities.justification: Browser line justification; this is not Knuth–Plass paragraph optimisation.
